certificationNote.venkatSai: Venkat Sai assesses your work and issues a certificate that records the result and the procedure used. Employers can check it online with its verification code.
certificationNote.accredited: The certificate is issued under {body}, an external awarding body. The institution running this course is authorised by Venkat Sai to issue it.
certificationNote.accreditedNoBody: The certificate is issued under an external awarding body named on the certificate.
certificationNote.completion: {provider} issues a certificate of completion when you finish the course.
certificationNote.none: This course does not lead to a certificate. You still keep the skills you learn.
certificationNote.notAccredited: This is not an external accredited qualification.

catalogue.noMatchDescription: Try removing a filter or searching for a different skill.
catalogue.emptyDescription: New courses and batches are added as soon as they are confirmed. Check back soon.
filters.label: Course filters
filters.includeWithoutBatches: Include courses without an open batch
public.metaDescription: Welding, technical and safety training from Venkat Sai and verified institutions, with open batches, fees and certificate types shown up front.
public.title: Training programmes
public.description: Courses from Venkat Sai and institutions we have verified. Every course shows its fee, schedule and exactly what certificate you can earn.
public.honesty: Courses never guarantee a job, and a course fee is never a condition for applying to a job.
detail.noDescription: The provider has not added a description yet.
detail.noSyllabus: The syllabus has not been published yet.
detail.outcomes: What you will be able to do
detail.batchesDescription: Dates, venue and seats for each batch. Choose one to apply.
detail.noBatchesTitle: No batch is open right now
detail.noBatchesDescription: New batches are listed here as soon as the provider opens them.
detail.noGuarantee: Completing a course builds your skills and record. It does not guarantee a job, visa or placement.
batch.notOpenYet: Enrolment for this batch has not opened yet.
batch.closed: Enrolment for this batch is closed.
talent.title: Training
talent.description: Your course applications and enrolments, schedules, attendance and results.
talent.emptyTitle: You have not applied for a course yet
talent.emptyDescription: Browse courses with open batches. Applying is free; any course fee is shown before you apply.
talent.currentDescription: Applications waiting for a decision and courses you are attending.
talent.noCurrentDescription: Find a course with an open batch to keep learning.
talent.assessmentsLinkBody: Trade and skill tests, results and verified skills.
talent.certificatesLinkBody: Certificates you have earned and their verification codes.
talent.discoverDescription: Courses from Venkat Sai and verified institutions. Filter by trade, mode, duration, fee and certificate type.
enrolment.title: Enrolment
enrolment.nextSteps: The training provider will review your application and confirm your place. We will notify you when it changes.
enrolment.resultsDescription: Scores appear here once the provider publishes them.
enrolment.noScores: No scores have been published yet.
enrolment.resultPending: Your final result will appear here when the course ends and marks are published.
enrolment.resultNotApplicable: This course is completion based and has no pass or fail result.
enrolment.certificateHint: Certificates you earn appear on your Certificates page.
withdraw.title: Withdraw from this batch?
withdraw.description: Your place or application will be cancelled and the seat offered to someone else.
withdraw.descriptionInProgress: You will be recorded as having left the course. Your attendance so far stays on record.
withdraw.success: You have withdrawn from the batch.
apply.title: Apply for a batch
apply.description: Applying for {course}. It is free to apply.
apply.batchUnavailableDescription: It may be closed or no longer listed. Choose another batch of this course.
apply.alreadyBody: Your application for this batch is {status}.
apply.disabledBody: Course applications are not being accepted at the moment. Please try again later.
apply.waitlistBody: You will join the waitlist. If a seat becomes free, the provider can offer it to you.
apply.sharingExplanation: To process your application, we share these details with {provider}:
apply.sharingPurpose: They use them only to contact you about this course.
apply.acknowledgeSharing: I agree that my name, email and phone number are shared with {provider} for this application.
apply.declaration: I confirm that the information in my profile is true, and I understand that completing a course does not guarantee a job, visa or placement.
apply.noGuarantee: Venkat Sai never charges candidates to apply for jobs. A course fee is never a condition for a job application, offer or placement.
apply.errors.contactSharing: Please agree to share your contact details with the training provider.
payment.title: Course fee and payment
payment.afterConfirmation: You do not pay anything to apply. {provider} will tell you how to pay once your place is confirmed.
payment.referenceHint: Quote the batch code as the payment reference and keep your receipt.
payment.institutionInstructions: {provider} will share its payment details directly. Pay only to the institution's official account and ask for a receipt.
payment.payOnlyConfirmed: Pay only after your place is confirmed, and always ask for a receipt.
payment.neverForJobs: Course fees are never a condition for applying to a job, an offer or a placement.
issuerType.venkat_sai: Issued by Venkat Sai (assessment or training result, not an external accreditation)
issuerType.accredited_external: Accredited certificate issued under an external awarding body
issuerType.institution_completion: Certificate of completion issued by the training institution
certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.description: Certificates issued to you through Venkat Sai Global, with codes employers can check.
certificates.honesty: Each certificate says who issued it. Venkat Sai assessment certificates record your test result and the procedure used; they are not external accredited qualifications.
certificates.emptyDescription: Certificates appear here when you complete a course or pass a Venkat Sai assessment.
certificates.publicOnHint: Anyone with the code can check this certificate's status.
certificates.publicOffHint: The code check is switched off. Employers will see no result.
verify.metaDescription: Check a certificate issued through Venkat Sai Global using its verification code.
verify.title: Verify a certificate
verify.description: Enter the verification code printed on the certificate to see whether it is valid.
verify.codeHint: 12 characters, for example ABCD-EFGH-JKMN. Hyphens and spaces are optional.
verify.formError: The certificate could not be checked
verify.notFoundBody: No certificate matches this code, or its holder has switched off online verification. Check the code and try again.
verify.status.valid.title: This certificate is valid
verify.status.valid.body: It was issued through Venkat Sai Global and has not been revoked or expired.
verify.status.revoked.title: This certificate has been revoked
verify.status.revoked.body: The issuer has withdrawn it. It should not be relied on.
verify.status.expired.title: This certificate has expired
verify.status.expired.body: It was valid until the expiry date shown below.
verify.rateLimitedBody: Too many checks came from your network. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
verify.footnoteAssessment: Venkat Sai assessment certificates record a Venkat Sai test result and the procedure used. They are not external accredited qualifications unless the certificate names an awarding body.
assessments.title: Assessments
assessments.description: Venkat Sai trade and skill tests: when and where, what to bring, results and the skills they verified.
assessments.freeTitle: You never pay for a job-related trade test
assessments.freeBody: Trade tests for a job application are paid by the employer or Venkat Sai. If anyone asks you to pay for one, do not pay and tell us.
assessments.emptyDescription: When an employer or Venkat Sai schedules a trade or skill test for you, the date, venue and instructions appear here.
assessments.whatToBringDefault: Bring a government photo ID. Your confirmation message lists anything else you need.
assessments.resultAwaited: Your result will appear here once it is published.
assessments.verifiedSkillsDescription: Skills verified by a passed Venkat Sai assessment. They show as verified on your profile.
assessments.noVerifiedSkills: No skills verified by assessment yet.
